ruleDefinitions.name: Using SettingSyncHost.exe as LOLBin
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects using SettingSyncHost.exe to run hijacked binary

sequences.query: NOT ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\"))) AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*RoamDiag\\\.cmd.*") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-outputpath.*"))
